packageRules.description: Group the OpenTelemetry Python suite — versions are interdependent
Group OpenFeature SDK + providers + hooks (co-constrained, see flagd provider 0.5.0 bump)

protobuf/gRPC toolchain: generated code is COMMITTED (proto/*_pb2.py, services/agent/gen, dashboard gen). Regenerate via `make protos-all` + `make protos-agent` when grpcio-tools/protobuf move; `ci-validate-protos` gates drift.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Generated proto code is committed. If `grpcio-tools` or `protobuf` changed, run `make protos-all` (and `make protos-agent` for the Go agent stubs) and commit the regenerated output before merging — the `Validate Proto Files` CI job gates drift.
